title: Listen opened without a tap
note: Opened by a link, a restored screen or a stale route (not by Speak), Listen waits at rest: the red circle and "Tap the red circle and talk." (S12). The microphone is not touched until the circle is tapped. On a phone the scribe://listen link goes to Tonight instead.
text: Close To Asha Only you, until you add it to the book. Tap the red circle and talk. Pause Finish
